headerDisplay: Configure your Philips TV (JointSpace API) including Ambilight, Hue sync, Wake-on-LAN, and Control Center remote buttons.

name.title: TV Name
name.description: Name of the television as it will appear in the Apple Home app.

ip_address.title: IP Address
ip_address.description: Local IPv4 address of your Philips TV.

poll_status_interval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_status_interval.description: Interval in seconds to poll the TV for power, audio, and lighting states. Set to 0 to disable polling.

has_ssl.title: Use HTTPS (SSL)
has_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS communication with the JointSpace API (required on 2016+ Android and 2018+ Saphi models).

has_ambilight.title: Enable Ambilight Control
has_ambilight.description: Expose Ambilight power and brightness controls in HomeKit.

has_hue.title: Enable Ambilight + Hue Control
has_hue.description: Expose Ambilight+Hue lamp power control (supported on Saphi and compatible Philips TVs).

has_chromecast.title: Built-in Chromecast Wake Support
has_chromecast.description: Access the Chromecast endpoint before waking the TV.

hide_input_selector.title: Hide Input Source Selector
hide_input_selector.description: Hide the HDMI/Source input selector in HomeKit.

info_button.title: Control Center Info Button Mapping
info_button.description: Remote key sent when pressing the Info button in the iOS Control Center remote (e.g., Options, Home, Source).

playpause_button.title: Control Center Play/Pause Button Mapping
playpause_button.description: Remote key sent when pressing Play/Pause in the iOS Control Center remote (e.g., PlayPause, Options).

wol_url.title: Wake-on-LAN URL
wol_url.description: Wake-on-LAN URL with the TV MAC address to wake the TV from standby.

etherwake_exec.title: Etherwake Executable Path
etherwake_exec.description: Optional path to an external etherwake binary if built-in WoL fails.

username.title: JointSpace Username
username.description: Pre-generated digest authentication username (required for 2016+ Android TV models).

password.title: JointSpace Password
password.description: Pre-generated digest authentication password (required for 2016+ Android TV models).
